name: Prepare and verify a JavaScript workspace
description: Create a project folder, edit a JavaScript file in VS Code, and run it with a supported Node.js LTS release from PowerShell.

name: Distinguish expressions, output, scripts, and the REPL
description: Choose between a saved script and a temporary REPL experiment, predict simple expression values, and explain visible console output.

name: Repair a basic execution or syntax failure
description: Use the command, file path, error line, and message to repair a wrong-folder run or a small JavaScript syntax error.

name: Declare and update named values deliberately
description: Use const for bindings that are not reassigned and let for values that must change during a program.

name: Recognize and inspect JavaScript value types
description: Work with strings, numbers, Booleans, undefined, and null, and use typeof while accounting for its documented null quirk.

name: Calculate and convert values predictably
description: Apply arithmetic precedence, numeric conversion, concatenation, and template literals without accidental string coercion.

name: Compare values without accidental coercion
description: Use relational operators and strict equality to produce and explain Boolean results.

name: Express decisions with Boolean logic
description: Use if, else if, else, AND, OR, and NOT to select one appropriate branch.

name: Reject invalid numeric input
description: Convert an input deliberately and use Number.isFinite before performing a calculation or comparison.

name: Manage an ordered collection with an array
description: Create, inspect, update, search, and safely address an array using indexes and length.

name: Process a collection with a bounded loop
description: Use for or for...of to visit intended values, accumulate a result, and avoid off-by-one boundaries.

name: Define and call a focused function
description: Write a named function with clear parameters and call it with appropriate arguments.

name: Return and compose useful values
description: Return a result from a function and use that result in another calculation or output operation.

name: Reason about local and outer scope
description: Keep temporary bindings local, identify an out-of-scope access, and avoid unintended dependence on mutable outer state.

name: Model one record with an object
description: Group related named properties, read and update them, and choose dot or bracket access intentionally.

name: Create simple instances with a class
description: Define a constructor and method, create instances with new, and distinguish shared class behavior from instance data.

name: Convert data to and from JSON safely
description: Explain JSON restrictions and use JSON.stringify and JSON.parse without confusing JSON text with live JavaScript objects.

name: Separate a program into ECMAScript modules
description: Export focused functions or classes, import them with matching names, and run the program in Node.js module mode.

name: Persist a small JSON data file defensively
description: Read and write UTF-8 JSON with Node.js while distinguishing a missing file from malformed existing data.

name: Verify and debug deterministic behavior
description: Use the Node.js debugger and built-in test runner with strict assertions to locate and prevent a small defect.

name: Dispatch a command from process arguments
description: Read process.argv, separate the command from its values, and route supported and unsupported CLI commands clearly.

name: Document and publish a safe Git repository
description: Write reproducible run and test instructions, inspect staged files, commit locally, and push a secret-free project to GitHub.
